pages.title: Tuning the Generator
pages.text: Seven modules exist purely to reshape how the $(l)Roost Generator$() behaves. Most cap at four installed; the Exciter goes further.$(br2)They interact, so read the whole family before committing to a build.
$(l)Capacity$(): doubles buffer size per upgrade, up to four.
$(l)Efficiency$(): plus 10 percent generation per upgrade, up to four.
$(l)Output$(): plus 12.5 points of output ratio per upgrade, up to four.
$(l)Exciter$(): plus 25 percent generation but adds 20 points of swing per upgrade. Eight of them unlock overdrive.
$(l)Stabilizer$(): cancels 10 points of Exciter swing per upgrade, up to 40 percent.
$(l)Surge$(): above 75 percent buffer, multiplies output ratio by 1.15 per upgrade, up to 1.6x.
$(l)Governor$(): trims 10 points of positive Exciter swing per upgrade and converts half of it into guaranteed generation.
